instruction.name: vftintrp.w.s
instruction.description: Convert single-precision floating point elements in `a` to signed 32-bit integer, rounding towards positive infinity.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vftintrp.w.s $vr0, $vr8; vftintrp.w.s $vr1, $vr9; vftintrp.w.s $vr2, $vr10; vftintrp.w.s $vr3, $vr11; vftintrp.w.s $vr4, $vr12; vftintrp.w.s $vr5, $vr13; vftintrp.w.s $vr6, $vr14; vftintrp.w.s $vr7, $vr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vftintrp.w.s $vr0, $vr8; vftintrp.w.s $vr1, $vr9; vftintrp.w.s $vr2, $vr10; vftintrp.w.s $vr3, $vr11; vftintrp.w.s $vr4, $vr12; vftintrp.w.s $vr5, $vr13; vftintrp.w.s $vr6, $vr14; vftintrp.w.s $vr7, $vr15'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
